localChanges: Late in a long game, waiting for the other civilizations had become several times slower, up to 12 seconds a turn on a large map with many players. It's back to about 2 seconds, and long GoTo routes are worked out faster too (closes #657).

log: `getByPlayers` filtered every interaction in the game with `isBetween`. Since civ1-unit's treaty-partners-land Impassable rule (civ-clone/web-renderer#287) asks it on every route-finding step onto a tile another player works, that scan was 61% of a late-game computer turn on a save with 3,480 interactions (civ-clone/web-renderer#657).

An interaction's players are fixed when it is made, so the registry now files each one under its players' sorted, unique ids with core-registry's `RegistryIndex`, which keeps registration order and hands back a copy, as the scan did. Raises core-registry to ^0.1.6, the first with `index`.
test: InteractionRegistry finds no-player interactions, Declarations, and re-registered ones in order
